question: Does the latest primary-author Emulating Emulsion package expose an exact, rights-auditable implementation plus fitted parameters or complete paired patch rows sufficient for a clean-room reproduction of its explicit 30-parameter baseline?

frozen_reported_design_facts.operator_family: 3x3 digital-to-film matrix, three four-parameter sigmoids in log exposure, 3x3 film-to-scan matrix

automatic_branch.pass: open one separately preregistered clean-room exact baseline reproduction with paired evidence and held-out controls
automatic_branch.code_without_parameters_or_rows: retain equation-family implementation evidence only and close reproduction
automatic_branch.parameters_or_rows_without_rights_or_lin: retain bibliographic facts only and close reproduction
automatic_branch.no_explicit_author_package: classify as paper-only mechanism and return to a materially distinct identifying-data or physical mechanism leaf

forbidden_fallbacks: reverse-engineer fitted parameters from figures, screenshots or sample images
download or align author sample photographs as unannounced paired training data
recreate missing patch rows from rendered examples
fit the equation family to the current 71 archive display-proxy pairs in this leaf
treat one roll, one process or one scanner as transferable stock response
call the 30-parameter colour equation a complete grain, halation, MTF or scanner-physics model
lower reproducibility, rights, lineage or data-completeness gates after inspection
